page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 5 57 Middle Street, County Durham Guide Price £110,000-£120,000 Result £149,000 Tenancy & Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC09 Consett 57 Middle Street, Consett, County Durham  DH8 5QG •   Freehold Retail Investment •   Let  to Christine Harrison (t/a Rapau Hair Design) until 2013 •   Current  Rent Reserved: £14,000  pa Location Consett,  with a population of almost 27,000, is located approximately 14 miles south-west  of Newcastle upon Tyne and 12 miles north-west of Durham. The town is situated close  to the junction of the A691 and A692, whilst the A68 trunk road provides a direct  link to the A1(M) (Junction 58) to the south. Rail services from Durham mainline  station to London (Kings Cross) have a journey time of about 3 hours 6 minutes. The  property occupies a prominent position on the west side of the pedestrianised Middle  Street at the junction with Raglan Street in the town's main retailing area. Nearby  occupiers include Age Concern, Select, Specsavers, Superdrug and HSBC Bank. Description The  property comprises a two storey terraced building arranged as a ground floor shop  with first floor ancillary accommodation. There is parking at the rear for two cars. Tenure Freehold. VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. Contact Oliver  Childs +44 (0) 20 7877 4517. E-mail: ochilds@savills.com Michael  Mallie +44 (0) 20 7409  8199. page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 17 Ty John Penri, 11 St Helens Road, Swansea Guide Price Sold Prior Result Sold Prior Tenancy & Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC04 Swansea Ty John Penri, 11 St Helens Road, Swansea SA1 4AL •   Leasehold Retail Investment •   Let  to Jeffrey Lang & Ethnic Youth Support Team until 2018 (1) •   Total  Current Net Rent Reserved: £26,250  pa Rising  to £31,250 pa in  2012 Location Swansea,  located on the South-West Wales coastline, is approximately 38 miles west of Cardiff  and has a population of approximately 223,301. The city is easily accessed off the  M4 (Junctions 42 to 45) and benefits from a regular mainline train service to London  (Paddington) with a fastest journey time of 3 hours 4 minutes. The  property is situated on the south side of St Helens Road close to the junction with  Wyndham Street, which is in close proximity to the city centre and the main shopping  thoroughfare, Oxford Street. The street is made up of a mixture of retail, residential  and leisure occupiers. National occupiers in the vicinity include Spar, Costcutter,  Co-Op Pharmacy and JD Wetherspoons. Description The  property comprises part of a recently developed mixed use scheme comprising residential  and commercial uses. We are offering the ground floor which comprises three retail  and commercial units. The upper floors are not included in the sale. Tenure Leasehold.  To be sold on a new 125 year lease from completion at a ground rent of £750  per annum to be reviewed every 25 years. VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot.
